name: Granqvist 2005 replication: Thomas right, then burst-firing both sides, sequenced coils
origin: Granqvist, Fredrikson, Unge, Hagenfeldt, Valind, Larhammar & Larsson (Uppsala/Lund), using the portable DAC unit with 4-channel commutator and Complex software v1.5 (printed as 1.15 in the paper) built and lent by Koren and Persinger (Laurentian University)
summary: A copy, for blinded self-tests, of the Uppsala double-blind test of the God Helmet: 15 min of the Thomas pattern stepped around four right-side coils, then 15 min of burst-firing stepped around both sides. With 43 exposed and 46 on sham, the paper reports no effect of the field; absorption, temporal-lobe signs and a New Age orientation predicted the exit-scale and mysticism scores, not the sensed-presence item.
notes: Granqvist 2005 p.3: two head boxes of four solenoids each, the signal cycling round them at 0.5 s per solenoid; 15 min of 'Thomas waves' (3-ms points, 3 ms between cycles) over the right side, then 15 min of 'burst waves' (3-ms points, 3000 ms between cycles) on both sides, or 30 min of sham. 89 undergraduates (43 field, 46 sham) were not told that a sham condition existed (p.3, p.4). The authors' reply names the software Complex v1.5, not 1.15; before each session only the unit's diodes were checked (Larsson et al. 2005 p.1 [348]). This program plays an 849-point Thomas table, 3 ms per point and 3 ms between passes; that Uppsala's file was this table is an assumption. Burst-firing is the project's rising sweep, 230 points of 3 ms, then 3000 ms; the point values were never published as numbers. In the two-sided phase one left-right pair is on at a time, and the right side is reversed so that the pair's field points through the head; Uppsala does not state the polarity, and the lab describes this hardware's fields as going 'through the brain' (Tsang 2004 p.6 [1018]). T7, FT7, FT9, T9 and their mirrors stand for the four solenoids of a head box. The site names are this project's reading and reach down to ear level; the paper has the boxes 'just above and in front of the ears' (p.3). The paper measured 3-10 uT at a distance estimated to match the intracranial one, with a BMM3 meter (p.3). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. Support: one double-blind study. Traits predicted the exit-scale and mysticism scores; 'none of the equations for the sensed presence item was significant' (p.5). Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Not for people with epilepsy or a seizure history; stop on fear or distress.
setting: Blindfolded, seated, with ear plugs, in a small (2 m x 2 m), quiet room with the light switched off. The helper says only that the session concerns 'the influence of complex, weak magnetic fields on experiences and feeling states', starts the Blind session, and gives the exit list afterwards without being told the condition.
schedule: One 30-min session per person in the original (between groups). Self-test: fix the number of Blind sessions in advance (e.g. 10, about half of them sham), at least a day apart, each rated before its reveal; trait questionnaires on a separate day.
